objective: Align current hardware release, manufacturing, safety, selection, and operations-readiness documents with the authoritative Revision D four-module holonomic robot without selecting unapproved supplier parts or claiming physical evidence.
acceptance: current release and safety documents identify Revision D as four independent 140 mm steer-drive modules
legacy Rev B/Rev C and 55 kg planning records are explicitly historical or removed from current selection claims
mass and operations-readiness summaries use the Revision D 77.5 kg analytical design case
all supplier candidates remain unapproved and all physical, safety, DFM, and certification gates remain fail-closed
hardware package tests, Ruff, and Task Packet validation pass
stop_conditions: a change requires selecting a final MPN or supplier AVL
a change would promote physical, EMC, safety, DFM, or certification evidence to complete
a change requires modifying PCB, motor-driver, firmware, robot-control, services, or interfaces ownership
